StmtSimple.StatementText: SELECT mmh.MemberId, mmh.GroupId, mmh.BranchId, mmh.ProgramOfficerId, mmh.StartDate, mmh.EndDate, m.Status, m.ClosingDate, m.AdmissionDate INTO #MoveHistory FROM [program].[MemberMoveHistory] mmh WITH (NOLOCK) INNER JOIN [program].[Member] m WITH (NOLOCK) ON m.id = mmh.MemberId WHERE (@BranchId = 0 OR mmh.BranchId = @BranchId)--mmh.BranchId = @BranchId AND mmh.StartDate <= @AsOnDate AND (mmh.EndDate IS NULL OR mmh.EndDate >= @AsOnDate) AND m.Status <> -1 AND m.AdmissionDate <= @AsOnDate AND (@MemberId = 0 OR mmh.MemberId = @MemberId) AND (@GroupId = 0 OR mmh.GroupId = @GroupId) AND (@EmployeeId = 0 OR mmh.ProgramOfficerId = @EmployeeId)

StmtSimple.StatementText: SELECT MemberId, [Member Status] INTO #tempMemberStatus FROM ( SELECT mh.MemberId, ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY mh.MemberId ORDER BY ba.Status DESC) AS row_num, CASE WHEN (ba.[Status] = 1 OR (ba.[Status] = 0 AND ba.[ClosingDate] > @AsOnDate)) THEN 'Bad-debt' WHEN (mh.[Status] = 1 OR (mh.[Status] = 0 AND mh.[ClosingDate] > @AsOnDate)) THEN 'Active' WHEN mh.[Status] = 0 THEN 'Inactive' END AS [Member Status] FROM #MoveHistory mh LEFT JOIN program.BadDebtAccount ba WITH(NOLOCK) ON ba.MemberId = mh.MemberId AND (ba.BadDebtTransferDate IS NULL OR ba.BadDebtTransferDate <= @AsOnDate) ) MemberCurrentStatus WHERE row_num = 1

ScalarOperator.ScalarString: CASE WHEN [AmmsOnlineProd].[program].[BadDebtAccount].[Status] as [ba].[Status]=(1) OR [AmmsOnlineProd].[program].[BadDebtAccount].[Status] as [ba].[Status]=(0) AND [AmmsOnlineProd].[program].[BadDebtAccount].[ClosingDate] as [ba].[ClosingDate]>[@AsOnDate] THEN 'Bad-debt' ELSE CASE WHEN #MoveHistory.[Status] as [mh].[Status]=(1) OR #MoveHistory.[Status] as [mh].[Status]=(0) AND #MoveHistory.[ClosingDate] as [mh].[ClosingDate]>[@AsOnDate] THEN 'Active' ELSE CASE WHEN #MoveHistory.[Status] as [mh].[Status]=(0) THEN 'Inactive' ELSE NULL END END END

StmtSimple.StatementText: SELECT rel.MemberId, MAX(CASE WHEN rel.Relation = 1 THEN rel.FullName ELSE '' END) AS FatherName, MAX(CASE WHEN rel.Relation = 2 THEN rel.FullName ELSE '' END) AS MotherName, MAX(CASE WHEN rel.Relation = 5 THEN rel.FullName ELSE '' END) AS SpouseName INTO #tempMemberRelation FROM #MoveHistory mem INNER JOIN program.[Relative] rel WITH(NOLOCK) ON mem.MemberId = rel.MemberId WHERE rel.Relation IN (1,2,5) GROUP BY rel.MemberId

StmtSimple.StatementText: SELECT TransferredMemberId, TransferredFromBranchId, TransferDate, ReceivingBranchId, ReceivingBranchWorkingDate, TransferStatus, CASE WHEN [TransferStatus] = 3 THEN 3 ELSE CASE WHEN ReceivingBranchWorkingDate <= @AsOnDate THEN 2 ELSE 1 END END AS CurrentTransferStatusWithInAsOnDate INTO #tempTransferMember FROM ( SELECT trm.TransferredMemberId, trm.TransferredFromBranchId, trm.TransferDate, trm.ReceivingBranchId, trm.ReceivingBranchWorkingDate, trm.TransferStatus, ROW_NUMBER() OVER(PARTITION BY trm.TransferredMemberId ORDER BY trm.TransferDate DESC) AS row_number FROM #MoveHistory mem INNER JOIN program.TransferReceiveMember trm WITH(NOLOCK) ON mem.MemberId = trm.TransferredMemberId WHERE trm.TransferDate <= @AsOnDate ) transMem WHERE row_number = 1

StmtSimple.StatementText: SELECT lt.MemberId, MAX(CASE WHEN lt.TransactionDate <= @AsOnDate AND lt.TransactionTypeId IN (4,10,12,43) AND (lt.IsReversed = 0 OR lt.Credit > 0) THEN lt.TransactionDate END) AS LastLoanPaymentDate INTO #LoanTransaction FROM #FilteredLoanAccount la INNER JOIN program.LoanTransaction lt WITH(NOLOCK) ON lt.AccountId = la.Id AND lt.BranchId = @BranchId WHERE la.DisburseDate <= @AsOnDate AND NOT EXISTS ( SELECT 1 FROM program.LoanTransaction lt2 WITH(NOLOCK) WHERE lt2.ReferenceTransactionId = lt.Id AND lt2.IsReversed = 1 AND lt2.TransactionDate <= @AsOnDate ) GROUP BY lt.MemberId OPTION (MAXDOP 8)

StmtSimple.StatementText: SELECT sa.MemberId, MAX(CASE WHEN st.TransactionDate <= @AsOnDate THEN st.TransactionDate END) AS LastSavingsPaymentDate, MAX(CASE WHEN sa.CategoryId = 4 AND st.TransactionDate <= @AsOnDate THEN st.TransactionDate ELSE 0 END) AS LastSecurityPaymentDate, SUM(CASE WHEN (sa.Status = 1 OR (sa.Status = 0 AND sa.ClosingDate > @AsOnDate)) AND sa.CategoryId = 2 AND sa.ProductId <> 204 AND st.TransactionDate <= @AsOnDate THEN st.Credit - st.Debit ELSE 0 END) AS PresentGeneralSavings, SUM(CASE WHEN (sa.Status = 1 OR (sa.Status = 0 AND sa.ClosingDate > @AsOnDate)) AND sa.CategoryId = 3 AND st.TransactionDate <= @AsOnDate THEN st.Credit - st.Debit ELSE 0 END) AS [Present CBS], SUM(CASE WHEN (sa.Status = 1 OR (sa.Status = 0 AND sa.ClosingDate > @AsOnDate)) AND sa.CategoryId = 4 AND sa.ProductId = 4 AND st.TransactionDate <= @AsOnDate THEN st.Credit - st.Debit ELSE 0 END) AS [Present Total LTS Balance] INTO #SavingsTransaction FROM #MoveHistory mh INNER JOIN program.SavingsAccount sa WITH(NOLOCK) ON sa.MemberId = mh.MemberId INNER JOIN program.SavingsTransaction st WITH(NOLOCK) ON st.AccountId = sa.Id WHERE st.BranchId = @BranchId GROUP BY sa.MemberId
